title: Navy astronomer measures wobbling disc

tellings.quote: New Mexico, this is in uh the very famous Life magazine article of 1947. One of the Navy's top astronomers observes

plain: A UFO researcher named Merrick points to a famous 1947 article in Life magazine, a popular American picture magazine. He says the article reports that one of the US Navy's top astronomers, in New Mexico, saw and measured a disc that wobbled as it flew. He raises it because it would mean a trained scientist recorded a flying disc in the very first year of the modern UFO story.
